locations.note: Michael, Trevor and Brad rob a bank in the 2004 prologue and Michael fakes his death; years later Trevor finds Brad buried in Michael's grave here.
In Los Santos, the game's Los Angeles, Michael De Santa's comfortable retirement unravels into heists with Franklin, Trevor and Lester, ending in the raid on the Union Depository's gold.
Recreated as Rockford Hills, where Michael lives in his mansion and the crew robs the Vangelico jewellery store.
Recreated as Vinewood under the Vinewood sign, where Michael and Franklin pull down a hillside mansion that turns out to belong to the drug lord Martin Madrazo.
Recreated as the Galileo Observatory, looking down on Los Santos from the Vinewood hills.
Recreated as Del Perro and Vespucci Beach, with the Del Perro Pier modelled on the Santa Monica Pier.
Trevor runs his meth business out of a Sandy Shores trailer and wars with the Lost, Merryweather and Wei Cheng's Triads.

routes.name: Michael, Franklin and Trevor
routes.note: From the snowbound Ludendorff robbery to a new life in Los Santos, Trevor's desert in Blaine County, a return to the grave in Ludendorff and the gold heist back in the city.
